summary: A 1932 steel tower, 35 ft, on Sassafras Mountain at the NC-SC line; the county library says it was removed. A 2019 observation tower is on the summit.

facts.status_note: Transylvania County Library says the Sassafras Mountain tower has been removed.
facts.agency: North Carolina Division of Forest Resources

access.note: Wikipedia describes an easy walk of about 300 feet from a parking lot to the summit, where a newer observation tower opened in 2019. It does not tie that tower to the 1932 site.

events.note: A 35-foot steel tower with an inside stairway and glass-enclosed cab. The lookout site and the county library both give 1932.
An observation tower opened on top of Sassafras Mountain. Sources do not say whether it stands on the 1932 site.

notes_for_editor: Brief status was unknown; the library's removal statement is the basis for removed. The brief's coordinates (35.065, -82.77722) match the state list entry NCT155 and sit close to the Wikipedia summit coordinates, but no source explicitly ties the 1932 tower to that point. Lookout site titles the page Sassafras Knob (MTN) but its NC entry reads SASSAFRAS MOUNTAIN. A search snippet mentioned a 1993 removal of an older tower on the SC side and a NCpedia Sassafras Knob listing; neither was fetched, so neither is used. Removal date unknown.
